QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] Fixing the Floral Flute 1
QuestInfo.0: The Floral Flute has wilted. Perhaps the Small Spirit knows how to save it?
QuestInfo.1:
You agreed to help restore the Floral Flute. Gather #r10#k of each of the following items: #b#i4036096:# #t4036096:##k, #b#i4036097:# #t4036097:##k, and #b#i4036098:# #t4036098:##k. You can get them from #r#o8644000##k, #r#o8644001##k, and #r#o8644002##k monsters.

QuestInfo.2: The Floral Flute looked to be revitalized by the offered lifeforce, but returned to its withered state. Maybe you need more?
